claims.sentence: Our primary outcomes were change in self-reported insomnia severity (Insomnia Severity Index (ISI)), sleep efficiency (SE) from sleep diaries, and change in SE and spindle density from polysomnographic (PSG) recordings collected at baseline and at post-intervention (16 weeks).
